name: Golfy Golf
summary:
Golfy Golf – The First and Only Social Golf Experience in VR!

Welcome to Golfy Golf, the groundbreaking Virtual Reality golf game that redefines what it means to tee off with friends. As the first VR golf game to feature a fully immersive social element, Golfy Golf brings the entire course to life like never before.
